# StraviFX

> StraviFX is an AI chart analysis app for Android. Point your camera at any forex, gold, stock or crypto chart (or pick a live market and timeframe) and it reads the market structure, makes a buy, sell or stand-aside call with a confidence score, and lays out the trade: entry, stop loss, two take-profit targets and a position size. Every setup is saved to a journal and tracked to its outcome. StraviFX is built by Infinytech Solutions in Nairobi, Kenya. It is sometimes written "Stravifx". It is not related to Strava or StriveFX.

StraviFX provides analysis for information and education only. It is not financial advice, it does not place trades, and its confidence score is not a probability of profit.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.stravifx.app/): what StraviFX does, how it works in six steps, features, markets covered and FAQ
- [Get the app on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.flavian.fxp): Android app, package com.flavian.fxp
- [Privacy policy](https://www.stravifx.app/privacy)
- [Terms of use](https://www.stravifx.app/terms)
- [Risk disclaimer](https://www.stravifx.app/disclaimer)
- [Delete your account](https://www.stravifx.app/delete-account)

## Tools

- [Lot size calculator](https://www.stravifx.app/tools/lot-size-calculator): position size in lots and units from balance, risk % and stop loss in pips, for USD-quoted pairs, USD/JPY and JPY crosses, USD/CAD, USD/CHF and gold (XAU/USD), with the formula and worked examples

## Facts

- Platforms: Android (Google Play)
- Markets: forex, stocks, crypto and gold; timeframes from 5 minutes to 1 week
- Hourly checks: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, XAU/USD, GBP/JPY, AUD/USD
- Inputs: a photo of a screen, a screenshot, or a live market with no chart needed
- Outputs: trend and structure in plain English, a call with confidence, an execution ladder (entry, stop, TP1, TP2 with pips and reward-to-risk), lot size from account equity and risk percentage, and a journal of outcomes
- Pricing: free to download, with optional subscriptions
- Support: stravifxapp@gmail.com
